limitations: The capture is Chromium-only: real model inference does not run on Playwright's WebKit on this Linux host (documented S4/S6 engine limitation); the WebKit side of A24's per-flow coverage remains the committed S6 evidence.

The model download in the video is served from the LOCAL cache by scripts/serve_model.mjs via the test-build-only ?testModelUrl flag (the same harness every e2e model flow uses) — the bytes, progress bar, streamed sha256 verification and cache promote are all real, but the remote Hugging Face fetch itself is not shown; no network re-download happened, per the pinned-model rule.

The OS share sheet cannot open in a headless browser: the Share click hands the exact payload to a spy (sanctioned by AGENTS.md), asserted to equal the edited review text; the sheet itself is a documented KNOWN_LIMITS item (A27 NOT_RUN).

Only the LLM-inference wait is time-compressed (239 s at 11x); the model download (26.8 s), OCR, editing, exports and the result are all natural pace. The factor is disclosed on screen during the segment and in size-comparison.json.

The browser e2e suite (Playwright Chromium + WebKit + production pass) was NOT re-run locally for this docs/demo-only slice: no digested path (src, public, e2e, fixtures, lockfile, package.json) changed — the source_digest is byte-identical to the S6-verified tree (0d42efe2…) — so the S6 full-suite evidence remains the proof for the app code; the required 'monorepo / verify' check runs that full suite on this PR's head in CI and must be green before the merge (per the merge policy).

The video was verified structurally (per-stage frame luminance stats, caption-band presence at the expected windows, segment durations against the wall-clock markers, plus the driver's in-run assertions); no human watched it on this runner.
